notes.title: Hollywood Animal is out now on Steam in Early Access! Weappy Sale starts!
notes.content:
Hollywood Animal Early Access is now available on Steam!

The current version of the game offers about 20 in-game years and over 30 hours of gameplay. We plan to release monthly content updates, along with regular fixes and tweaks.

A lot has changed since we released the Christmas demo, so we strongly recommend starting a fresh save.

For the first week, Hollywood Animal will be available at a 10% discount.

notes.title: Early Access Release Date, New Demo and Video
notes.content:
In Hollywood Animal, you'll take the lead of your own film studio, and carve out a place for yourself under the bright Californian sun. But it won't be enough to just place buildings, and hire people, and come up with stories to make into films. After all, you're not the only dreamer in this town. And this time, your competitors aren't the background abstractions you might be expecting in this genre. No, these rivals are cunning, insidious, and willing to cross any line. You'll find out about all it – and much more – in the new gameplay video.


[previewyoutube=oDFPTtGHyno;full][/previewyoutube]

Put your skills to the test on January 16, 2025, when Hollywood Animal goes live on Steam Early Access. And in case you want to practice a little, before your full-on clash with the Hollywood heavyweights, we have prepared a new free demo for you, coming in December.

Wishlist and follow!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680550/Hollywood_Animal/

- Weappy Wholesome

notes.title: Patch #4 (1.1.1.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35778023/f6ce6897074be8a4cf62bd7369143d3ff5d8cbf1.png

Fixed a bug in unlimited save points where player couldn't save if they already used up all their points
Fixed a bug in Rebel Yell where trying to pick up two loot boxes close to each other too fast could freeze the game

notes.title: Brand New "Rebel Yell" mode + now you can turn infinite saves on!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35778023/7c8146014581b3dd16796c78fd60221c24393054.png

Take four cops with random perks and skills, and hold out for as long as you can against endless waves of scum and vermin. You'll start out with trusty knives, and everything else you'll have to scavenge from the battlefield. But that's not gonna stop you, right?

And, of course, your results will go to Steam Leaderboards!

Also:

 Now you can turn infinite saves on from the menu on any difficulty
 Now, when you finish the game, you automatically get achievements for beating it on lower difficulties
 Other small fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Patch #3 (1.0.11.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35778023/96a1a987c521bdbafe486964442340785aa57659.png


2X save points for each extra job in Normal mode
Some fixes and improvements to the final mission
Fixed freeze after the boat cutscene in Estate mission
Fixed freeze after enemies got shot in the leg by brothers in Estate mission
Fixed an achievement
Some other minor fixes

notes.title: Patch #2 (1.0.9.0) - Speedy Hotfix
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35778023/8cc91830cfa28c2a80da6c3110e82aacea66d684.png

Hi! We respect your time and effort put in Rebel Cops, so now you can speed up the game (x3 times) by holding down V button on your keyboard or D-pad right on a controller.

Cheers!

notes.title: Patch #1 (1.0.8.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35778023/b7b8a52408d18746b5da014c29636ea460942f78.png


 Fixed an issue that would prevent the game from starting if the number formatting in Windows language settings was set to Turkish.
 Extended the time limit in the Railway mission by 2 turns
 Fixed a bug that could freeze the game if clicked on a unit's card in some situations.
 Buttons like "End Turn", "Proceed" and others don't need to be held down anymore when using the mouse.
